core.description: Core — platform-free: a Gesture Provider that any touch source feeds plain finger samples, finding its zones through a Zone Tree it is handed; the Direction a touch first moves; what a Swipe decides; the Tree Walk a picker moves through as a finger goes; and the Thumb Lock, a still left thumb beside a moving finger. No DOM, no React, no Motion: a browser and a phone both build on it. The provider, the Direction, the Tree Walk and the Thumb Lock are worklets, so a phone can run them on its UI thread.

provider runs the one Gesture under way and reads its Direction; swipe judges a Swipe by Direction; tree-walk reads a finger's moves as Directions through a tree; thumb-lock is a provider listener that reads a still left thumb beside a moving finger. Each stands on direction, and thumb-lock on provider too.

entry.description: Entry: the package root, the platform-free core's one door: what a touch source on any platform builds on.
